notes.title: Update 1.3.2
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Update 1.3.2 is live!

This update adds a new way to navigate the Adventure menu, and fixes a huge bug in Boss fights.

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Adventure menu has been reworked and the chapters are now integrated within the world map for easy navigation.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TWvDFIl.gif[/img]

[*] Major bug fix where Bosses used to still damage the reaper when their health reaches 0.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Update 1.3 is finally here! 

This update adds a lot of new things, now the levels have a grim and dark atmosphere thanks to the new color palette, new enemy type, new OSTs, a boss rework and bug fixes.

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Complete overhaul of the game's color palette.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gupPEeU.gif[/img]

[*] Reworked "The Wise One" boss attacks and animations.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2HGhTE1.gif[/img]

[*] New enemy type in Chapter 2.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Q32LR2e.gif[/img]

[*] New OSTs added, enjoy more climatic boss music.

[*] And A LOT of bug fixes as usual!
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2.3
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Update 1.2.3 is live! 

This update brings a lot of fixes and some new features as part of my continues efforts to improve the game.

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added "Skip Dialogue" button.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tT199Sk.png[/img]

[*] Adjustments to bosses/AI difficulties.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Lcwg6qn.png[/img]

[*] The basic attack has a shorter cooldown.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/S5BVmTt.gif[/img]

[*] And more bug fixes! yay!!
[/list]
